verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's Incident Workflows provide configurable triggers and actions with "if-this-then-that" logic. Workflows can fire automatically on matching incidents (e.g., all P1/P2) and include actions such as sending a webhook POST. Event Orchestration adds rules to automatically deduplicate or suppress alerts, and AI Orchestrations can recommend such rules. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of rule automation, and detailed documentation of Event Orchestration rule conditions and the action catalog.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Through highly-configurable triggers and actions, you can apply "if-this-then-that" logic to orchestrate the right response for your teams, processes, and business.
For example, you can configure one workflow that automatically triggers for all P1 and P2 incidents
Event Orchestration: Automatically deduplicate or suppress alerts.
Send a POST request with a customized body and headers.
automatically analyze historical events and incidents and surface recommended rules that reduce noise, improve MTTR, and accelerate automation setup
